mapper.select: SELECT NAME, SCOPES, DESCRIPTION, VERSION, CREATED_AT FROM ROLES WHERE 1=0
SELECT ROLE_NAME, SCOPE, CREATED_AT FROM ROLE_SCOPE WHERE 1=0
SELECT NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM ROLES WHERE NAME=#{name}
SELECT NAME, DESCRIPTION FROM ROLES ORDER BY NAME
SELECT VERSION FROM ROLES WHERE NAME=#{name}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ROLES (NAME, SCOPES, DESCRIPTION, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{name}, #{scopes}, #{description}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO ROLE_SCOPE (ROLE_NAME, SCOPE, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{roleName}, #{scope}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT SCOPE FROM ROLE_SCOPE WHERE ROLE_NAME=#{roleName} ORDER BY SCOPE
mapper.update: UPDATE ROLES SET SCOPES=#{scopes}, DESCRIPTION=#{description}, VERSION=VERSION+1 WHERE NAME=#{name} AND VERSION=#{expectedVersion}
